name: Florence
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: an Arthurian hero and an illegitimate son of Gawain

text: Florence was a hero of the Arthurian tales. The great knight Gawain fathered several sons outside wedlock. Florence was one of them. Lancelot took his life. At the time Lancelot sat shut inside queen Guinevere's bedchamber. He fled the room with his blade bared and cut down Florence.

okr.objective: Florence is the Arthurian hero who died by the sword of Lancelot.
key_results: He was one of the illegitimate sons of the great knight Gawain.
Lancelot struck at the moment he fled queen Guinevere's bedroom.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
